api-removed-v0.title: Runbook: instantiate a client and call the resource method, the v0 module-level call has no v1 equivalent

missing-api-key.title: Runbook: pass api_key explicitly or set OPENAI_API_KEY, which key is correct is a decision about credentials, not something to guess at

invalid-api-key.title: Runbook: the key itself is wrong, generate or correct it at platform.openai.com, this is not a code change
